# Pygame Zero distribution

Unmodified pgzero 1.2.1 wheel from https://pypi.org/project/pgzero/1.2.1/.
Source: https://github.com/lordmauve/pgzero (version 1.2.1).
License: GNU LGPL 3 or later; COPYING and AUTHORS are also included in the wheel.

SHA-256: `734e1de1a99804c2610f90aa419411fc2b31200b9d683b6c9fc710c7a8e36606`

Python Lab installs this pure-Python wheel with dependency resolution disabled because its game runtime supplies pygame-ce and NumPy. The upstream pygame dependency is satisfied by pygame-ce's compatible import API, not by a second pygame installation.
